goals.title: Make Tiny-Yeah attach to and run from OpenCode launched on Windows 10...
goals.objective: Make Tiny-Yeah attach to and run from OpenCode launched on Windows 10 with PowerShell 7.6. Deliverable: a reliable installer/package/plugin path that a Windows user can run immediately after prerequisites, with doctor/install/OpenCode plugin smoke evidence. Context: previous research found real OpenCode surfaces exist, but current repo is not immediately ready: raw install needs a bundle, generated release bundle can be airGapComplete false, verify:offline can fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, full npm run check fails in installer e2e and Playwright sandbox, pwsh is absent on this macOS host, and Windows-host execution must be represented by portable tests plus explicit Windows commands until a real Windows host is available. Constraints: do not overclaim Windows execution without a Windows host; preserve user changes; use failing-first proof; Node >=22.5, PowerShell 7+, OpenCode >=1.4, npm cache isolation, and .opencode plugin loading are the target surfaces.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/data happy path: in a temp target project, run npm_config_cache=<tmp-cache> node bin/tiny-yeah.js install --project <tmp-project> --bundle <unpacked-bundle-dir> --yes --json, then run node bin/tiny-yeah.js doctor --project <tmp-project> --json, then run a Node import smoke from <tmp-project>/.opencode that imports tiny-yeah/opencode and asserts createTinyYeahPlugin exposes tiny_yeah_install_check. PASS iff install exits 0, doctor has zero fail checks except documented host-only pwsh warning on non-Windows, and import smoke prints hasInstallCheck=true.

Edge/adversarial path: run node bin/tiny-yeah.js install --project <tmp-project> --bundle release/tiny-yeah-offline-v1.0.0.tar.gz --dry-run --json and run the new/updated test that proves tarball bundle input is either supported by extraction or rejected with a precise actionable error before any .opencode writes. PASS iff command behavior matches documented contract and temp project remains without .opencode managed install files.

Regression/quality path: run npm run typecheck, npm run build, targeted installer/opencode tests, and package/offline verification with isolated npm cache. PASS iff changed behavior is green and any remaining host-only Windows proof gap is recorded explicitly rather than hidden.
